query:
SELECT (
             EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM pplns_payout_history
               WHERE "blockHeight" = $1 AND "paidSats" <> 0
             )
             OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM pplns_group_block_history
               WHERE "blockHeight" = $1 AND "paidSats" <> 0
             )
             OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM blockparty_block_history
               WHERE "blockHeight" = $1 AND "coinbaseValueSats" <> 0
             )
           ) AS "exists!"
